description_ar: أجواء فاخرة: خلفيات كحلية داكنة مع ذهبي، خطوط ديوانية وكلاسيكية، حركة بطيئة أنيقة وظهور تدريجي.
description_en: Luxury mood: deep navy backgrounds with gold accents, classical Arabic calligraphic type, slow elegant motion and soft fades.
scene_blueprint_en: Open on near-black with a faint gold radial glow and sparse slow particles; the title fades/blur-ins slowly.
Use thin gold lines as dividers that draw in (animate size.w); generous empty space.
Finish with a calm centered signature line and a subtle glow pulse.
rules_en: Slow pacing: entrance durations 0.9-1.4 s, easing easeOut/easeInOut only (no bounce/elastic).
Titles in Amiri weight 700; secondary text in Aref Ruqaa or Cairo 500.
Gold (#fbbf24) only for emphasis; everything else white/slate on navy.
